My friend and former House colleague, Rep. Mia Love, is facing a heartbreaking battle with brain cancer.
 
I’m heartbroken to learn that Mia no longer is responding to treatment. She has decided to spend her remaining time surrounded by her family and those she loves.
 
Her tragic health development has deeply touched many, as Mia’s  contributions to our Nation and her trailblazing role in Congress are significant. My prayers remain with her and her loved ones during this incredibly challenging time; please keep her in yours.

Thanks to the PSU College of Medicine for inviting me to their conference in Hershey. The discussion on AI and Human Factors was both timely and thought-provoking—highlighting the need for innovation with technology in medicine.
 
I appreciate the leadership and vision coming out of Penn State College of Medicine, as well as our continued working relationship.

This is National EMS Week. A special “Thank You” to our Emergency Medical Professionals serving on the front lines of crises and care - 24/7, 365. Paramedics, EMTs, and EMS personnel are tireless, dedicated, skilled, and compassionate in the face of so many contingencies - ranging from serious to unspeakable life-or-death situations. THANK YOU for your selfless service.

The U.S. Census was mandated in our Constitution as a measurement of the American People, where we’re going as a Nation, how our communities determine where to build schools to supermarkets to homes to hospitals. It also helps the government decide how to distribute funds / assistance to States and localities, and how to draw legislative districts and the seats for each State in Congress.  It represents Citizens of the United States.

Joined my colleagues in creating the Rural Health Transformation Program (RHT) to rebuild rural healthcare infrastructure and address the root cause(s) of the healthcare crisis facing rural America.
 
RHT lets us recruit/retain healthcare professionals, provide doctors and hospitals with cash stability, and shift incentives away from treatment and toward real health outcomes. 
 
(Why did every House Democrat vote against this?)
